newsitem.title: FRANCE: Retail OAT sales set at 12.66 bln to end Sept 1997.
newsitem.headline: Retail OAT sales set at 12.66 bln to end Sept 1997.

text.p: The French Treasury said on Tuesday banks and financial institutions had agreed to buy 12.66 billion francs of government bonds (OATs) for sale to private individuals in the coming 12 months.
The Treasury said in a statement it was renewing an existing agreement and that the financial institutions were making firm orders for 12.66 billion for the period October 1996 to September 1997.
